Package org.cibseven.bpm.engine.rest.mapper

Class JacksonConfigurator

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.rest.mapper.JacksonConfigurator
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ContextResolver<tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper>
@Provider @Produces({"application/json","application/hal+json"}) public class JacksonConfigurator extends Object implements jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ContextResolver<tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper>
Provides the Jackson ObjectMapper of the REST API.

The mapper keeps the JSON format of the Jackson 2 based REST API: it starts from the Jackson 2 defaults of Jackson 3 (JsonMapper.builderWithJackson2Defaults()), writes dates as text in dateFormatString (in the JVM default time zone) and ignores unknown properties. Beyond those defaults it keeps the Jackson 2 accessor names (e.g. get_links()) and the Jackson 2 limits for nesting depth and string length; the maximum string length can be changed in jackson.properties.

Jackson 3 mappers are immutable, so the mapper is built once and shared. It is rebuilt when the date format (setDateFormatString(String)) or the JVM default time zone changes. To add modules or features, start from configureObjectMapper().rebuild().

The JAX-RS JSON providers of the REST API (CibsevenJacksonJsonProvider) and the resources look the mapper up as ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>, so an application can replace this class with its own resolver.

    Class
    Description
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2AccessorNaming
    Property names of getters and setters like Jackson 2, which Jackson 3 no longer offers: leading upper-case letters are lower-cased (getURL() is "url", not "URL"), and accessors whose name continues with a lower-case letter, a digit or "_" (getvalue(), get1st(), get_links()) are properties as well.
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2CompatibilityModule
    The Jackson 2 compatible serializers and deserializers of this mapper.
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2EnumLikeSerializers
    Month as enum ("JANUARY") like Jackson 2, with all enum settings and @JsonFormat; Jackson 3 writes the month number (0).
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2LocaleDeserializer
    Reads a Locale like Jackson 2, also the form Locale.toString() writes for a script or extensions ("zh_TW_#Hant", "th_TH_#u-nu-thai"): Jackson 3 would drop the script and the extensions.
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2LocaleKeyDeserializer
    Reads Locale map keys like JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2LocaleDeserializer.
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2SqlDateSerializer
    Date like Jackson 2: written as text without a format on the property, it is the value's own toString() ("1970-01-01"); Jackson 3 uses the mapper's date format instead.
    static class 
    JacksonConfigurator.Jackson2YearSerializer
    Year like Jackson 2: a number only if dates are written as timestamps, otherwise text ("2020"); Jackson 3 always writes a number unless the property says otherwise.
